availability_notes: kempsey.nsw.gov.au (the current, non-archive site) returns HTTP 403 Forbidden to every automated fetch attempted (WebFetch and curl with full browser headers alike), unlike archive.kempsey.nsw.gov.au (SRC-0001). A Wayback Machine snapshot exists (2025-07-08, confirmed via archive.org's availability API and a successful HEAD request), but every GET attempt returned HTTP 498; not pursued further, since repeatedly varying request headers to force through a bot-detection block crosses into deliberate evasion. This is likely the most current single record of project status and should be checked manually (in an ordinary browser) in a future collection run - it is currently an access gap, not a confirmed absence of information.

authority: Southern Cross University (relaying Save Our Macleay River citizen science project)
title: Citizen science and mining impact on Macleay River
availability_notes: scu.edu.au returns HTTP 403 Forbidden to this session's fetch tool (see DEC-0008). Per search-engine snippet: a seven-year (2016-2023) citizen science water-quality study by Save Our Macleay River volunteers and SCU's Professor Scott Johnston found arsenic and antimony from historic mining tailings at Bakers Creek, below Hillgrove, persisting in the Macleay River catchment. Not yet linked to any thread - this concerns arsenic/antimony from an upstream historic mining source, a different contaminant to this case's iron/manganese focus, and it is not yet established whether it bears on Willawarrin or Bellbrook's own water supply specifically rather than the wider catchment. Registered for completeness pending confirmation of relevance; not to be treated as evidence of an effect on this case's two towns without further primary-source confirmation.
